# Flaus

> Flaus is the world's first eco-friendly, electric flosser brand combining sustainable dental care with innovative sonic-vibration technology.

Founded by Samantha Coxe, Flaus offers electric flossers and accessories designed to make oral health easier while reducing environmental impact through a comprehensive recycling program. The brand emphasizes sustainability, clinical research, and customer satisfaction with flexible payment options including HSA/FSA.
